description: Software does not validate or incorrectly validates input that can affect control flow or data.
Improper neutralization of input during web page generation allowing script injection.
Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory (dot-dot-slash).
Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor.
Improper authentication allows an attacker to disguise as another user.
Weaknesses related to the management of permissions and privileges.
Application deserializes untrusted data without sufficiently verifying validity.
Memory buffer operations do not properly restrict bounds.
Software reads data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.
Software writes data past the end, or before the beginning, of the intended buffer.
Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL Command.
Web server does not verify that request was intentionally sent by submitter.
Weaknesses related to cryptography and key management.
Improper resource management like memory leaks or unclosed handles.
Software does not properly restrict consumption of scarce system resources.
Software does not restrict or incorrectly restricts access to a resource.
Software does not properly assign, modify, or track privileges.
Use of broken or risky cryptographic algorithms.
Software does not perform an authorization check when an actor attempts an action.
Software performs authorization but improperly validates credentials.
A NULL pointer dereference occurs when application dereferences null.
Software performs calculation that can produce integer overflow.
Software does not validate or incorrectly validates certificate.
Software allocates resources without limiting maximum amount.
Weakness type not categorized or missing in upstream commit.
